# Leo Operations
> Black-owned political consulting and media firm in Nashville, TN. Campaign strategy, field organizing, video and photo production, websites, social media and digital ads for candidates, causes and brands nationwide.

## Guides
- [Signature Gathering for a Ballot Initiative: What It Costs and How It Works](https://leooperations.com/guides/ballot-measure-signature-gathering/): Paid initiative drives averaged a record $14.87 per required signature in 2024. State signature rules, circulator pay, validity padding and timelines.
- [Brand videos: what they are, the examples worth studying, and how to plan one for your company or yourself](https://leooperations.com/guides/brand-video/): What a brand video is, famous brand video examples and what they teach, brand video ideas, personal brand videos for founders, and the right length.
- [Campaign video production: what campaign videos and political ads cost to make](https://leooperations.com/guides/campaign-video-production-cost/): Campaign videos run from a few hundred dollars DIY to $25,000 to $100,000+ for a statewide TV spot. What drives cost, what to make, and how to brief a crew.
- [What paid canvassing costs, how many doors per hour to expect, and whether door knocking still works](https://leooperations.com/guides/canvassing-cost-and-effectiveness/): Paid canvassers earn about $18 to $30 an hour, and full programs often run $3 to $6 per door. Doors per hour, contact rates and whether canvassing works.
- [Churches and political candidates: what the IRS allows, what changed in 2025 and 2026, and how to plan any church event well](https://leooperations.com/guides/church-events-and-political-candidates/): Churches can host candidate forums, voter registration and nonpartisan guides, but as of October 2026 the IRS ban on endorsing candidates still applies.
- [How to live stream church services well: equipment, platforms, music licensing and a volunteer workflow](https://leooperations.com/guides/church-live-streaming/): What you need for church live streaming: cameras, a stream audio mix, an encoder, about 10 Mbps upload, a platform and a music streaming license.
- [Church photography: a shot list, a photo policy and the settings that work in a dark sanctuary](https://leooperations.com/guides/church-photography/): A church photography shot list for Sundays, baptisms and anniversaries, a photo policy with child consent, low light camera settings, and how to use the photos.
- [Church social media strategy: the right platforms, a weekly calendar, post ideas and a policy that protects your people](https://leooperations.com/guides/church-social-media/): A practical church social media strategy: platform use by age (Pew 2026), a weekly calendar, sermon clips, post ideas and a policy for photos of minors.
- [Church website design: what every church website needs, builders vs. custom, giving, accessibility and cost](https://leooperations.com/guides/church-website-design/): What a church website needs (service times, plan your visit, sermons, giving), builders at $19 to $199 a month, and custom design market ranges.
- [Corporate video production: what it is, the types that work, and how to create corporate videos step by step](https://leooperations.com/guides/corporate-video-production/): Corporate video production is planning, filming and editing video for a company or organization. The types, ideas, step-by-step process and 2026 costs.
- [How much does it cost to run for office? Real numbers from city council to president](https://leooperations.com/guides/cost-to-run-for-office/): A city council race can cost under $5,000. The average 2022 U.S. House winner spent $2.79 million and Senate winners $26.5 million. Full costs by office.
- [Hiring a Destination Wedding Photographer and Videographer: Costs, Travel Fees and Logistics](https://leooperations.com/guides/destination-wedding-photographer/): A destination wedding photographer costs their base rate plus travel: flights, lodging, ground transport, travel days. How fees work and what to ask.
- [Engagement Photos: What They Cost, What to Wear and How Not to Look Awkward](https://leooperations.com/guides/engagement-photos/): Engagement photos usually cost $300 to $1,500, or come free in a wedding package. When to schedule, what to wear, how to relax and use them well.
- [How Much Does an Event Photographer Cost?](https://leooperations.com/guides/event-photographer-cost/): Event photographers typically charge $150 to $500 an hour in 2026, and a corporate event averages about $1,130 on Bark. See rates, what's included and how to hire.
- [The First Look at a Wedding: What It Is, Pros and Cons, and How to Plan One](https://leooperations.com/guides/first-look-wedding/): What a wedding first look is, the honest pros and cons, first looks with dad or the bridal party, and how a first look changes your photo timeline.
- [How to plan a get-out-the-vote program that moves turnout, based on what the field experiments show](https://leooperations.com/guides/get-out-the-vote-plan/): The GOTV tactics with the best evidence are personal: door knocking, friend-to-friend asks, plan-making. How to build universes and run the last 72 hours.
- [Professional headshots: what they cost, what to wear, how to pose and how to run a team session](https://leooperations.com/guides/headshot-photography/): How much a pro headshot costs in 2026 ($216 to $427 typical), what to wear, headshot poses, backgrounds, smiling, and running team headshots on location.
- [How to get people to show up to your event, with the turnout math organizers use](https://leooperations.com/guides/how-to-get-people-to-show-up-to-your-event/): Expect 25% to 50% of free-event RSVPs to no-show. How to plan turnout math, promote on a timeline, confirm attendees and fill the room every time.
- [How to Hire a Political Consultant (and What They Actually Charge)](https://leooperations.com/guides/how-to-hire-a-political-consultant/): Political consultants charge retainers, media-buy commissions (traditionally 15%), mail markups and win bonuses. What each firm does and what to ask first.
- [How to host a political fundraiser, from a living-room house party to a host-committee reception](https://leooperations.com/guides/how-to-host-a-political-fundraiser/): To host a political fundraiser, set a dollar goal, recruit a host committee, make a direct ask and follow FEC rules: $3,500 per election in 2025-2026.
- [How to organize a community event that people attend and remember, from a town hall to a block party](https://leooperations.com/guides/how-to-organize-a-community-event/): To organize a community event, set one clear goal, check permit lead times, book a space, recruit volunteers and invite every attendee to sign in.
- [How to organize a concert or rally, from the permit application to the last song](https://leooperations.com/guides/how-to-organize-a-concert-or-rally/): Organizing a concert or rally takes 8 to 16 weeks, permits, insurance and a run of show. Small events run $5,000 to $40,000. Costs, rules and a timeline.
- [How to recruit and manage volunteers, the way organizers actually build teams](https://leooperations.com/guides/how-to-recruit-and-manage-volunteers/): Recruit volunteers by asking people directly, then keep them with confirmation calls, real roles and a ladder of engagement. Scripts, tables and tools.
- [How to run for mayor or city council (and actually win)](https://leooperations.com/guides/how-to-run-for-mayor-or-city-council/): How to run for mayor or city council, from filing and signatures to fundraising, your win number, field plan and election day, with a worked example.
- [How to build a political campaign budget (with sample budgets at $100K, $1M and $10M)](https://leooperations.com/guides/political-campaign-budget/): How to build a campaign budget, what percentage goes to media, field, mail and staff, and sample budgets at $100K, $1M and $10M with cash-flow timing.
- [Political digital advertising: how to plan, target and spend a campaign's digital budget](https://leooperations.com/guides/political-digital-advertising/): How to plan a political digital ad budget across Meta, YouTube, CTV and search, with $25K, $100K and $1M sample splits plus each platform's 2026 rules.
- [Political Direct Mail and Text Messaging: What It Costs, What the Law Says, and What Works](https://leooperations.com/guides/political-direct-mail-and-texting/): Political mail typically runs $0.50 to $0.70 per piece all-in; P2P texts about 2 to 4 cents a segment. Costs, USPS rules, TCPA, 10DLC and what works.
- [How much does a political TV ad cost? Production, airtime and how campaigns actually buy TV](https://leooperations.com/guides/political-tv-ad-cost/): A 30-second political TV spot runs from under $100 in small markets to $75,000+ in top-10 prime time. Here is how airtime, GRPs and production add up.
- [Professional social media graphics: why polish matters and how to get it right](https://leooperations.com/guides/professional-social-media-graphics/): Polished social graphics build trust and read well on phones. Current image sizes, a brand system, approval steps and where a designer matters most.
- [35 Questions to Ask a Wedding Photographer and Videographer Before You Book](https://leooperations.com/guides/questions-to-ask-wedding-photographer/): 35 questions to ask a wedding photographer and videographer before you sign, grouped by topic, with why each matters and the red flags to walk away from.
- [How to make a recruitment video that gets the right people to apply](https://leooperations.com/guides/recruitment-video/): How long a recruitment video should be, 12 recruitment video ideas, real examples, and where to post it so the right people watch and apply.
- [How Super PACs and Independent Expenditures Work, and How They Spend Money](https://leooperations.com/guides/super-pac-independent-expenditures/): Super PACs raise unlimited money but cannot coordinate with candidates. How to start one, FEC 24/48-hour reports, and what $1M, $10M or $100M buys.
- [Testimonial videos: how to film customer and client stories that people believe](https://leooperations.com/guides/testimonial-video/): What a video testimonial is, the interview questions to ask, permission and FTC rules for customer testimonials, examples, and how to edit and use them.
- [Testimonials and reviews: how to capture credible ones and use them everywhere](https://leooperations.com/guides/testimonials-and-reviews/): 97% of consumers read online reviews and voters trust people like them. How to film credible testimonials, get consent and follow FTC review rules.
- [How Much Does a Video Production Company Cost?](https://leooperations.com/guides/video-production-cost/): A video production company typically charges $4,500 to $20,000 for a corporate video and $15,000 to $50,000+ for a brand film in 2026. See costs by type and length.
- [How Much Does a Videographer Cost Per Hour and Per Day?](https://leooperations.com/guides/videographer-cost/): Professional videographers charge about $60 to $150 an hour and $600 to $1,200 a day in 2026; specialists run $2,000 to $3,500+. See event and corporate rates.
- [How to run a voter registration drive, from one table at a festival to a $10 million multistate program](https://leooperations.com/guides/voter-registration-drive/): A voter registration drive costs about $30 to $45 per completed form with paid staff. How to plan one, follow state rules, prevent fraud and scale to $10M.

Compare one team vs two vendors, budget splits and day-of crew logistics.
- [How Much Does a Wedding Photographer Cost in 2026?](https://leooperations.com/guides/wedding-photographer-cost/): The average wedding photographer costs about $3,000 (The Knot, 2026). See hourly rates, 2 to 8 hour prices, what drives cost and how to judge a quote.
- [Wedding Photography Timeline: Sample Schedules for 4, 6 and 8 Hours of Coverage](https://leooperations.com/guides/wedding-photography-timeline/): Sample wedding photography timelines for 4, 6 and 8 hours of coverage, with and without a first look, plus photo order, buffers and golden hour timing.
- [The Wedding Shot List: Every Must-Have Photo and Video Shot, Plus a Family Photo Template](https://leooperations.com/guides/wedding-shot-list/): A complete wedding shot list by part of day, a family photo grouping template, cultural moments to add, and a videography shot list for vows and toasts.
- [How Much Does a Wedding Videographer Cost, and Is It Worth It?](https://leooperations.com/guides/wedding-videographer-cost/): The average wedding videographer costs $2,300 (The Knot, 2026); most pros quote $2,000 to $4,800. See what drives the price and whether video is worth it.
- [Wedding Videography Styles Explained: How to Choose the Film You Will Actually Rewatch](https://leooperations.com/guides/wedding-videography-styles/): Cinematic, documentary, traditional and journalistic wedding video styles explained, plus highlight vs feature films, same-day edits, drones, turnaround.
- [When to Book a Wedding Photographer and Videographer, and What Happens After You Do](https://leooperations.com/guides/when-to-book-wedding-photographer/): Book your wedding photographer 9 to 12 months out, 12 to 18 for peak fall Saturdays. Deposits, photos per hour, delivery times and tipping norms.
- [Who Pays for What in a Wedding: Tradition, 2026 Data and How to Talk About It](https://leooperations.com/guides/who-pays-for-what-in-a-wedding/): The bride's family traditionally paid for most of the wedding. Now 52% of couples say family paid all or most. See the who-pays table and budget split.
- [Why a professional website matters for candidates, campaigns and businesses](https://leooperations.com/guides/why-a-professional-website-matters/): People judge a website in about 50 milliseconds, mostly on design. What a campaign or business site needs, what it costs and a launch checklist.
